relations: Green beams from the central emitter rotate, sweeping their paths across the building facade and the crowd below.
Volumetric fog catches the light, so beam brightness and spread change as the emitter angle shifts.
The blue projection on the facade warps and slides as the laser source moves relative to the wall.
The right-side operator silhouette stays largely stationary while adjusting the rig that drives the beam motion.
